titulo: Heathrow airport roads reopen after flooding from burst water main
cuerpo: Heathrow says airport operating as normal after passengers told not to travel by road and use rail and tube instead Disruptions caused by flooding from a burst water main on a ring road at Heathrow airport restricted access to Terminals 2 and 3 on Saturday morning. The leak has been contained and the affected areas are operating as normal. Water in the central terminal area prevented anyone trying to travel by road to or from Terminals 2 and 3. Passengers had to travel by rail and tube instead. Access to the carparks was also impeded, leaving people with parked cars unable to access them. Continue reading...
